proof_scope: Battle feature regression coverage through existing Battle entrypoints, local Docker proof receipts, local transport receipts, receipt-backed Pixi replay browser proof, focused contract suites, an explicit fail-closed adaptive-lineage exact-chain receipt gate, and explicit uncovered seams for Battle features that still need agentic evals

claims.proves: Battle's authorization gate, isolated local Docker reactive Judge round, Red/Judge/Blue visibility boundary, scorekeeper authority, terminal semantics fail-closed validation, adaptive-lineage contract guards, durable adaptive-lineage exact-chain proof, browser-visible receipt-backed Pixi replay, immutable-goal close-gate readiness, Pydantic arena/Red/Blue/play-by-play event receipts, commentary causality, memory-lineage contract guards, same-run transport, pause/resume transport safety, and staging fail-closed behavior are covered by agentic eval seams with artifact readback
claims.does_not_prove: arbitrary target exploitability, a real 1000-round overnight campaign, QEMU boot execution, production WebSocket TLS/auth/fanout against a real public endpoint, or full visual design acceptance

what_was_exercised: uv-run Battle probe script invocations that call Battle run.sh commands, local Docker proof generation, current-status terminal-semantics receipt readback, focused pytest contract suites, independent JSON receipt readback, and a built spectator bundle served over local HTTP for Playwright Pixi replay proof
what_remains_unverified: external staging authority bundle (#1149), production WebSocket TLS/auth/fanout against a real public endpoint, a real 1000-round overnight campaign, QEMU boot execution, arbitrary target exploitability, and full visual design acceptance

capability_claims.description: Battle rejects mutated target/action/runtime/expiry/probe authorization before execution
Battle CLI authorization is bound to the actual target path or Docker image passed to the orchestrator, and caller aliases are accepted only through an explicit same-target mapping.
A clean local Battle repair round runs through the isolated Docker target and emits complete Red/Judge/Blue/scorekeeper receipts
Red observation is unconfirmed until Judge #1, proactive Blue cannot see private Red findings, and reactive Blue receives only Judge-confirmed findings
Judge #2 distinguishes exploit blocking from functionality preservation before Blue success is awarded
Scorekeeper uses Judge receipts, not Blue self-claims, as the scoring authority
Adaptive lineage primitive Judge probes cannot assign live Red or Blue success without target execution and quarantine synthetic process probes as non-security proof.
Adaptive lineage contract tests reject slot mutation, replay mismatch, invalid parent/child lineage, and reducer drift
battle-004 fresh exact-byte Red/Blue adaptive-lineage campaign binds campaign, artifact-integrity, backend-verification, provider-authority, and Docker Judge receipts

Dogpile and memory readback receipts seed the Generation 2 provider/Tau mutation prompt; provider responses cite those seed hashes before child specimens are materialized, Docker/Judge replayed, selected, and rendered into Pydantic-validated arena, Red activity, Blue activity, and sports play-by-play commentary receipts.
Verified primitive Docker Judge receipt digests are computed from the finalized receipt file bytes or retained in a separate descriptor that matches those final bytes.
Provider/Tau seeded-lineage broadcast checks reject absent replay counters and empty provider seed-citation collections instead of passing vacuous evidence.

Provider/Tau broadcast selection reporting validates selection receipt shape separately from child-promotion canary observations and truthfully narrates child promotion, parent retention, and no eligible promotion.
Provider/Tau broadcast commentary lines fail closed unless they cite the exact bound arena receipt or nonempty valid activity indices from the exact bound team activity receipt.

Provider/Tau broadcast commentary narrates scenario objective, Red mechanism, Blue response, replay transition, and Judge terminal result only from typed source-bound receipt fact slots, omitting absent facts and unsupported kill language.

Selected provider/Tau Red and Blue lineage children are durably written through the Memory skill only after per-team admission and independently recalled by marker, team, artifact digest, and fitness evidence digest.

Memory promotion writes require a validated per-team admission decision, generation-correct selected artifact and fitness evidence, and recall readback binding marker, team, artifact digest, and evidence digest on the same recalled item.

CURRENT_STATUS.json binds the newest durable adaptive-lineage qualification plus retained Pixi/browser proof and fails closed when the immutable primary proof or Pydantic event-commentary receipts are missing or stale
The current-status checker rereads the selected proof manifest, recomputes referenced receipt hashes, validates schemas, and rejects cross-campaign substitutions before accepting MET.
Battle current-status validates local MVP terminal semantics through typed Judge/scorekeeper evidence and rejects kill, fastest_crash, promotion aliases, and crash-only promotion.
CURRENT_STATUS check rejects promotion of explicitly unsupported readiness claims unless each claim is bound to its required receipt class.

A paired battle-004 Docker Judge replay distinguishes lineage existence from a retained promoted Blue artifact causing a predeclared Judge/functionality metric improvement, with a same-treatment negative control.
Battle immutable goal close gate requires both durable adaptive-lineage exact-chain proof and browser-visible PixiJS replay evidence
Adaptive memory selection, ablation, and evidence contracts prevent Red/Blue lineage regressions
Same-run transport emits ordered HTTP/SSE/WebSocket payloads and frontend reducers reject gaps/malformed events
Receipt-backed Pixi replay derives parent/child visibility from the served fixture and supports scrub on the browser-rendered route
Battle live transport fails closed on bad Last-Event-ID resume inputs
Production readiness does not pass without required local and external staging receipts
The long-running Battle loop checkpoints, resumes, stops, reports, and preserves status across a multi-round or overnight run
Advertised git_worktree, copy, and QEMU/firmware digital twin modes isolate execution and emit receipts with dynamic target toolchain identity
General Red/Blue Tau handoffs use public-only scenario inputs, provider-authored artifacts, and fail closed when provider/authorship evidence is missing
Team-isolated Memory writes, recalls, promotions, nonpromotions, and negative evidence are live and cannot leak opponent-private state
Dogpile/Brave/GitHub research receipts seed Red/Blue strategy from the host side without granting target-container network or host execution
A same-run authorized Battle emits Red, Blue, Judge, scorekeeper, adaptive lineage, and Memory promotion/nonpromotion receipts for one parent-child selection loop
Dynamic Docker-backed swarm execution proves worker concurrency and timeout controls beyond fixed two-worker fixtures
The monitor accepts schema-valid human interjections only through the backend contract and fails closed when orchestration handling is absent
Pixi replay gameplay is captured in browser video/screenshots showing play, pause, resume, scrub or restart, motion, nonblank rendering, and no runtime errors
Production readiness passes only with positive route, auth, rollback, teardown, WebSocket fanout, and deployment-alignment receipts
A small/medium local Battle produces Docker Judge-backed mixed Red/Blue outcomes plus per-round scan, attempt, and adaptive-lineage commentary in retained receipts
Fast offline sanity receipts cannot satisfy live backend qualification proof rungs; live gates require matching live receipt classes.
Consumer-owned campaign profiles resolve MAY_REJECT choices, never downgrade the spec floor, and fail closed on unknown overrides, missing required cases, and malformed profiles.
